title: Evaluating AlphaEarth Foundations Embeddings for Wildfire Susceptibility Mapping
abstract: arXiv:2608.12663v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Wildfire susceptibility mapping typically relies on physical variables assembled from multiple remote-sensing, climate, and geospatial products. AlphaEarth Foundations (AEF) provides analysis-ready geospatial embeddings that may reduce this dependence on heavy harmonisation and task-specific feature engineering, but their value for wildfire susceptibility mapping has not been systematically evaluated. Using Victoria, Australia (2017-2025), as a case study, we show that AEF embeddings can reconstruct commonly used variables in wildfire susceptibility analysis with high accuracy. In downstream susceptibility models trained on satellite-derived fire occurrence data, embedding-based susceptibility models achieve ROC-AUC values above 0.92 and consistently identify high wildfire susceptibility across eastern Victoria, particularly Gippsland and the north-eastern uplands, with additional localized hotspots in central and northwestern Victoria

translated_title: 评估AlphaEarth基础嵌入在野火易发性制图中的应用
translated_abstract: 野火易发性制图通常依赖于从多个遥感、气候和地理空间产品中整合的物理变量。AlphaEarth基础（AEF）提供了可直接用于分析的地理空间嵌入，可能减少对重型数据协调和特定任务特征工程的依赖，但其在野火易发性制图中的价值尚未得到系统评估。以澳大利亚维多利亚州（2017-2025年）为案例研究，我们表明AEF嵌入能够以高精度重建野火易发性分析中常用的变量。在基于卫星衍生的火灾发生数据训练的下游易发性模型中，基于嵌入的易发性模型实现了ROC-AUC值超过0.92，并一致识别出维多利亚州东部的高野火易发性区域，特别是吉普斯兰和东北部高地，同时在维多利亚州中部和西北部也发现了局部热点。
tldr: 本文首次系统评估了AlphaEarth基础嵌入在野火易发性制图中的价值，证明其能高精度重建常用变量，并构建出ROC-AUC超过0.92的高性能易发性模型，有效识别维多利亚州高风险区域。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically evaluates AlphaEarth Foundation embeddings for wildfire susceptibility mapping, showing they reconstruct common variables with high accuracy and yield susceptibility models with ROC-AUC above 0.92, effectively identifying high-risk zones in Victoria.
